name: Horseradish and Cranberry Sauce
subtitle: From Greta (and Susan Stamberg’s)
notes: The relish will be thick, creamy and shocking pink (“OK, Pepto Bismol pink.”).

steps.title: Grind the cranberries
steps.body: Grind or chop **2 cups whole raw cranberries**, washed, and **1 small onion** together.

steps.title: Mix
steps.body: Add everything else and mix: **¾ cup sour cream**, **½ cup sugar** and **2 Tbsp horseradish from a jar**.

steps.title: Freeze
steps.body: Put in a plastic container and freeze.

steps.title: Thaw
steps.body: Early Thanksgiving morning, move it from the freezer to the refrigerator compartment to thaw. It should still have some little icy slivers left.
